description: SemVer comparator inverts pre-release precedence rule, rating pre-releases higher than normal releases.

tests.test_semver_comparator.py:
from semver import SemVer
from matcher import SemVerComparator


def test_major_minor_patch_comparison():
    v1 = SemVer.parse("1.2.3")
    v2 = SemVer.parse("1.2.4")
    v3 = SemVer.parse("2.0.0")
    assert SemVerComparator.compare(v1, v2) == -1
    assert SemVerComparator.compare(v2, v1) == 1
    assert SemVerComparator.compare(v3, v2) == 1
    assert SemVerComparator.compare(v1, v1) == 0


def test_prerelease_lower_than_normal_release():
    # 1.0.0 is strictly GREATER than 1.0.0-alpha
    release = SemVer.parse("1.0.0")
    prerelease = SemVer.parse("1.0.0-alpha")
    assert SemVerComparator.compare(release, prerelease) == 1
    assert SemVerComparator.compare(prerelease, release) == -1


def test_prerelease_lexicographical_comparison():
    v_alpha = SemVer.parse("1.0.0-alpha")
    v_beta = SemVer.parse("1.0.0-beta")
    assert SemVerComparator.compare(v_alpha, v_beta) == -1
    assert SemVerComparator.compare(v_beta, v_alpha) == 1


def test_v_prefix_parsing():
    v = SemVer.parse("v2.1.0")
    assert v.major == 2 and v.minor == 1 and v.patch == 0


def test_equal_prereleases():
    v1 = SemVer.parse("1.0.0-rc.1")
    v2 = SemVer.parse("1.0.0-rc.1")
    assert SemVerComparator.compare(v1, v2) == 0


def test_sorting_version_list():
    raw = ["1.0.0", "1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-alpha", "0.9.0", "2.0.0"]
    versions = [SemVer.parse(r) for r in raw]
    # Bubble sort using comparator
    for i in range(len(versions)):
        for j in range(len(versions) - 1):
            if SemVerComparator.compare(versions[j], versions[j + 1]) == 1:
                versions[j], versions[j + 1] = versions[j + 1], versions[j]
    assert [f"{v.major}.{v.minor}.{v.patch}" + (f"-{v.prerelease}" if v.prerelease else "") for v in versions] == [
        "0.9.0", "1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0", "2.0.0"
    ]
